items.title: Monday: 24 finals, 142 goals and 12 series updates
items.html:
All 12 wildcard matchups have four confirmed games. Six series are tied at 2–2 and six stand 3–1. Monday had 142 goals and three overtime decisions. The original bracket and Predictor Challenge remain untouched.

Evidence note: No November 16 player box-score lines are yet present in the parser. Only verified game results, confirmed totals and clearly dated pre-Monday player context are used.

Read every series in full, with official game links → · Night in Review →

items.title: WHL wildcard preview
items.html:
Two 5-vs-4 series split the spotlight. Swift Current faces Red Deer in the East, while Victoria meets Penticton in the West. Each series is first to four wins.

  • No. 6 Kelowna Rockets vs. No. 2 Tri City Americans
